description: Get base-station settings for a system: entry/exit delays, alarm volume and duration, door chime, voice prompts, plus base-station health (wifi/cellular signal, wall power, backup battery, RF jamming). Does not include PINs — use simplisafe_get_pins for those.

sid.description: System id. Optional when the account has exactly one system; required when it has several.

name: simplisafe_get_settings
